services.title: OUR SERVICES
services.subtitle: Comprehensive engineering solutions tailored to your needs, powered by cutting-edge technology and decades of expertise.

3d.title: 3D MODELING
3d.desc: We transform client data into accurate 3D models to visualize designs and detect potential issues early. This process allows for easy review, modification, and validation before proceeding to detailed drawings.

2d.title: 2D DETAILING
2d.desc: Our 2D detailing process ensures every dimension, material and component is clearly defined for production. We create precise technical drawings that serve as the foundation for efficient manufacturing.

inspection.title: PARTS INSPECTIONS
inspection.desc: We conduct through inspection and quality checks on fabricated parts to ensure accuracy and consistency with design specifications. Using advanced measuring tools, we guarantee top-notch quality before assembly.

assembly.title: MACHINE ASSEMBLY
assembly.desc: In collaboration with our trusted partners, we provide reliable assembly services for completed parts and machinery. Our goal is to deliver high-performance, ready-to-use systems built with precision and efficiency.

projects.title: BRINGING VISION TO REALITY
projects.subtitle: See how our precision - driven designs turn ideas into successful engineering solutions.

dedimpler.title: DEDIMPLER AND FACER
dedimpler.desc: Tube and pipes require facing and or internal and external chamfering can be processed in line with the tube mill or off line.

looper.title: LOOPER MACHINE
looper.desc: Horizontal loopers store strips on a horizontal rotary table. Where the space is available this is the most efficient and cheapest method of storing strips without causing any surface damage.

forming.title: FORMING AND SIZING MACHINE
forming.desc: After metal has been welded and combined it will undergo forming to produce the needed shape of steel.

shear.title: SHEAR WELDER MACHINE
shear.desc: Shear and end welders crop the tail and nose of each coil. The two coil ends are then aligned and the joint welded using TIG, MIG or MAG depending on the material and thickness being welded.

table.title: FINISHING TABLE
table.desc: Extension of transfer table in the finishing line.

line.title: FINISHING LINE
line.desc: After pipes are cut into standard lengths it will be passed to the finishing line to be arranged and bundled ready for distribution.

milling.title: MILLING CUTOFF MACHINE
milling.desc: Milling Cutoff Machine uses two milling saws to cut length pipe and structural section tubes. The cut finishes eliminates the need for facing.

furnace.title: FURNACE
furnace.desc: Furnace is used for melting large batches of glass, in which heat is supplied by a flame playing over the glass surface.
